column1: # Reference-tool packages for the cnc-gcode judge: LinuxCNC's standalone
# RS274/NGC interpreter `rs274` and its two runtime libraries not shipped
# inside the linuxcnc-uspace .deb.  setup.sh downloads each URL, verifies the
# sha256, and extracts it rootless (dpkg-deb -x) into $HOME/.cnc-gcode/rs274.
# Debian bookworm main + bookworm-security (amd64), all older than two weeks.
